prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Russian civilization Bronze Age BRONZE AXEMAN, single animated soldier sprite sheet for a top-down RTS.
Primary request: An imagined ancestral roster, not a historically literal Slavic army. Broad bronze axe head and ROUND WOODEN SHIELD give the new infantry an unmistakable silhouette.
Reference image: Approved Russian Stone Age clubman sheet for the painted rendering, overhead camera and established red/cream cultural identity ONLY. Create a Bronze Axeman rather than another clubman; one soldier per frame, never a formation.

Subject: Robust infantryman with red wool cloth cap, cream fur brim and collar, muted red linen tunic, pale linen trousers, brown belt and boots. Subtle bronze reinforcement on cap band and wrist guards signals progression. RIGHT hand on SCREEN-LEFT holds a short timber haft with a broad single curved bronze axe blade, thick bronze socket, clear golden copper alloy edge; weapon is visually a broad AXE, not a stone club or sword. LEFT forearm on SCREEN-RIGHT holds a round plank-built wooden shield, visible circular shape and timber grain, leather-bound rim and small bronze central boss. No national flag, heraldry, modern insignia, full plate or steel weapons.
Camera: STRICT straight VERTICAL OVERHEAD orthographic looking down onto cap crown, shoulders, shield face and top of feet. Soldier faces SCREEN-DOWN; no isometric view, horizon or upright portrait face. Preserve the reference's top-down body proportions.
Composition: Exactly1536x1024 transparent RGBA, EXACT3 columns x2 rows of six512x512 cells. ONE COMPLETE soldier in each. Consistent foot/body root at local256,285 and same size throughout. Entire soldier +complete axe+shield fits inside a centered400x400 area, leaving at least56px EMPTY transparent padding on every cell edge. No neighboring pixels cross any cell boundary. Axe/shield remain fully visible and distinct from the red torso. Keep silhouettes clean and strong at32/48/64pixel game scale.
MOTION: Six small chronological IDLE poses forming a subtle breathing/weight shift loop. Knees planted; shoulders rise and settle gently, axe and shield subtly settle with breathing. Frame6 returns closely into frame1. Six distinct poses, not duplicate copies.
Rendering: Detailed stylized painterly game art like the reference, controlled lighting, warm bronze contrasting red fabric and dark timber. True transparent background: no background haze, vignette, glow, cast shadow, text, labels, grid or blood. Exactly two arms, two legs, one axe and one shield in every frame; complete fingers, toes, axe blade and round shield.
